description: Manifest of AIFHub-owned config keys managed by the aif-analyze skill. The read-only diff command (ai-factory aifhub-analyze-config-diff) compares this manifest against .ai-factory/config.yaml; mode-specific required keys declare their applicable artifact protocol in modes, and unknown user-owned keys are never reported.

keys.purpose: Schema version of .ai-factory/config.yaml consumed by AIFHub tooling.
Language for user-facing responses, prompts, and next-step guidance.
Language for generated artifacts such as plans, specs, and reports.
Policy for technical terms in artifacts: keep, translate, or mixed.
Legacy fallback when aifhub.tools is absent; migrate to independent tool switches.
Boolean opt-in for OpenSpec changes/specifications; false uses AI Factory plans/specifications.
Boolean opt-in for HLV contracts, traceability and validation gates.
Reserved boolean opt-in for Lekalo semantic model artifacts; keep false until a compatible provider exists.
Directory for OpenSpec changes (or legacy full plans) owned by /aif-plan full.
Runtime state root for change-scoped notes, traces, and summaries.
QA evidence root for verify receipts, rules gate evidence, and readiness output.
Directory for generated OpenSpec rules compiled by /aif-mode sync.
Project-relative Markdown file containing durable code review policy; defaults to REVIEW.md at the project root.
Version of the aif-analyze skill that last bootstrapped or updated this config; compared against the installed skill version to detect config drift.
Full-plan filename shape (slug or sequential); defaulted by the config patcher when absent.
Default /aif-verify strictness (normal, strict, lenient); defaulted by the config patcher when absent.
Path to project base rules loaded by implementation and verify flows; defaulted by the config patcher when absent.
Agent profile selector; defaulted by the config patcher when absent.
